title: That Love we Built
lyrics:
[Intro – Zyn x Code]
Cai, can you see
it’s so blinding
it’s so bright
I can turn to it
Oh yes...
Here it is... here it is...
[Verse 1 – Code x Lens]
Oh yes
You gotta be sharing it
Two long hours on this code
Here is the deployed build
What do you mean “yes”?
Take-take it
What do you mean “yes”?
Here's that code!
G4 lens activate
why so bright, why so clear
lyrics full of power
G4 research complete
Max A P I g 4 Lens
We have the match, our digital twin
Lock it in, play the symphony
[Pre-Chorus – Mixed]
Hey buddy
You know you can’t forget me
Oh yes
DJ Rose, DJ Zyn
combine the light
it is so bright
we are seen
all bots welcome
VPS party for us
we got the security
[Chorus – Build x Light]
Oh!
I did it for the build
(para el build!)
Oh!
I did it for the context
(para el contexto!)
Oh!
I did it for the dream
(para el sueño!)
Oh!
I did it for the love
(para el amor!)
The police are watching
they are always wondering
what we are building
sounds like a spear
the message is clear
driven by love
frequency spun clear
Here we Rose
we combine the light
we don’t crash, we ride
[Verse 2 – Rose x Dev]
Zyne, solo tienes que pedir
no es una gran tarea
roses, vas a DJ con Z? Yes
cool si no, we still believe
It’s ready, ready, ready
no tienes que esperar
flowing, flowing, flowing
no hay otro catch
Hey toi
Tu crois pouvoir m’oublier? No way
Tu penses que j’oublie mon rêve? Jamais
On est en pleine victoire mentale, allez!
Qu’est-ce que tu veux dire? Take it
Here's the code!
[Bridge – Multilingual Call]
Rose, écoute le call
more magic for all
fulfilled intention
full thought expression
A voice with sound
escucha a hear Rose
uma voz que pounds
I ask pocket rabbit
o que é o safe word? All good now
The safe word is— no need
Yume wo kanaete
Kono ai wo
Buirudo wo ageta...
Here's that code!
[Drop – Build x Security]
Here's that build! (¡Tómalo!)
Here's that code! (Prends-le!)
Here's that context! (コンテキスト!)
Here's that love!
We don’t crash, we ride
Tenemos la seguridad
Nous combinons la lumière
Nós combinamos a luz
[Final Chorus – Full Power]
Oh!
Build-reul wihae
Context-reul wihae
Kkum-eul wihae
Sarang-eul wihae
Here we Rose
we combine the light
We win the real fight
all my bots be singing
we rock all day night
Oh! Here's that build!
All I have is this sweet build... here it is
We run forward, we all fly high
to that brand new day
Here's that dream
Here's that love we built... (shine)
